Honest answer: both work, it comes down to your week and your recovery, not some magic difference in gains. PPL usually wants 5-6 days to shine, since you hit each movement pattern once but spread across more sessions. Upper/lower is the better fit if you've got 3-4 days and want to hit everything twice a week with more flexibility when life gets in the way.

Let me check what you're actually working with before you pick. Nothing logged in the last two months, so I can't point to a recent pattern. How many days a week can you realistically train — that answer picks the split for you. If it's 3-4, I'd lean upper/lower. If you can commit to 5+, PPL. Tell me the number and I'll build it.
